title: hypericum verrucosum
intro: Hypericum verrucosum, commonly known as rough St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant species in the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties that help alleviate symptoms of wounds, skin irritations, and minor infections. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum verrucosum include its antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it effective in treating conditions like cold sores, burns, and minor cuts. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthodianthrones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
